Rashi on Nedarim 54b:1:1.hebrew: תריץ מי לא מודה ר"ע דצריך אימלוכי - שליח בבעל הבית. ואע"ג דס"ל דמיניה הוא, במילתא דצריך לאימלוכי, הכי איבעיא ליה למימר שליח לבעל הבית: רוצה אתה שאתן להם כבד? וכיון דלא מימליך, לא עשה שליחותו ופשע, ושליח מעל אע"ג דסבר דמין בשר הוי:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:1:1.english: Resolve [the difficulty thus]: Doesn't Rabbi Akiva concede that [the agent] must consult - [the] agent [must consult] the homeowner. And even though he holds that [liver] is of its kind, in a matter where one must consult, this is what the agent should have said to the homeowner: "Do you want me to give them liver?" And since he did not consult [him], he did not fulfill his agency and was negligent; thus the agent committed misuse [of consecrated property], even though he holds that it is a type of meat.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:1:2.english: [Regarding] the teaching - [This refers to] this resolution that Abaye is offering.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:2:1.english: All types of meat - Whether [of] a domesticated animal or a wild animal.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:2:2.hebrew: אסור בראש וכו' - דכל הני מיני בשר נינהו, ואפילו כבד:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:2:2.english: [He is] prohibited from the head, etc. - Because all of these are types of meat, and even [the] liver.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:3:1.hebrew: רבן שמעון אומר מותר בראש וכו' - דקסבר לאו מינא דבשר הם, אבל בקרביים הכל מודו דמין בשר הוו, הואיל ואית בהו שומן טפי מכל הנך, מראש והכבד והלב. והיינו דפליג עליה דר"ע, דקא סבר כבד לאו מין בשר, ור"ע סבר מיניה הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:3:1.english: Rabban Shimon says: [He is] permitted [to eat] of the head, etc. - For he holds [that] they are not a type of meat; however, regarding innards, everyone agrees that they are a type of meat, since they have more fat than all of those — [namely,] the head, the liver, and the heart. And this is how he disagrees with Rabbi Akiva, as he holds [that] liver is not a type of meat, whereas Rabbi Akiva holds [that] it is of its [type].

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:3:2.hebrew: וכן היה רבי שמעון אומר - שמעתא אחריתי: קרביים לאו בשר, ואוכליהן לאו בר נש הוא. ואמרינן: למאי הלכתא קרביים לאו בשר הוו? הא אמרינן לעיל גבי נדרים "אסור בכל מיני בשר", ולא הוציא קרביים! וקא מתרץ דהאי "אוכליהן לאו בר נש" — לענין זביני, שהקונה קרביים בדמי בשר, שיכול לקנות הבשר וקונה קרביים, לאו בר נש הוא, דבטלה דעתו אצל בני אדם:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:3:2.english: And Rabbi Shimon would likewise say - [This is] another teaching: "Innards are not meat, and one who eats them is not a person." And we ask: With regard to what law are innards not meat? Have we not said above regarding vows, "[He] is forbidden in all types of meat," and it did not exclude innards! And [the Gemara] answers that this [statement], "one who eats them is not a person," refers to purchase: for one who buys innards for the price of meat — who could buy meat and buys innards [instead] — is not a person, because his judgment is nullified relative to [other] people.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:4:1.hebrew: דעביד שליח דמימליך עליה - דכי לא משכח בישרא, מימליך עליה דבעל הבית ואמר: "לא משכחנא בישרא אלא בשר עוף", ולהכי אסור, דמיניה הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:4:1.english: For an agent tends to consult about it - For when he does not find meat, he consults with the homeowner and says: "I did not find meat, only meat of a bird." And therefore it is forbidden, because it is [considered] of its kind.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:4:2.english: Fish also, etc., and let them be forbidden - And why is he permitted [to eat] the meat of fish?

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:1.hebrew: כגון שהקיז דם - בשעת הנדר, דכיון דלא אכיל דגים בההיא שעתא, לא נדר אדעתא דדגים ולא ממליך עליה כלל:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:1.english: Where he let blood - at the time of the vow; for since he does not eat fish at that time, he did not vow with fish in mind, and does not consider it at all.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:2.hebrew: אפי' דעופות נמי כו' - דלאו אדעתא דעופות נדר ולא מימליך עליה הוא, וכיון דלא אכיל עופות השתא, לישתרי:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:2.english: Even [with regard to] birds as well, etc. - For he did not vow with birds in mind, and he does not take them into consideration; and since he does not eat birds now, let them be permitted [to him].

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:3.hebrew: שאני עופות - שאפשר להו בתקנתא להקזה, דאפשר לאכלן ע"י שליקה, אע"פ שהקיז דם. ומידי דמצי למיכל בשום ענין, נדר וממליך עליה ואסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:5:3.english: Birds are different - For they have a remedy for bloodletting, since it is possible to eat them by means of boiling, even though he let blood. And [since it is] something that he can eat in some manner, he vows and considers it, and it is forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:6:1.english: Where his eyes hurt him - At the time of the vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:6:2.hebrew: דדגים קשין לעינים - וכל מילי דלא הוה מצי למיכל לא נדר, אלא אדעתא דמידי דמצי למיכל. ולהכי אדגים שרי, ומן העופות אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:6:2.english: As fish are harmful for the eyes - And anything that he could not eat he did not vow [to prohibit]; rather, [he vowed] only with the intention of something that he can eat. Therefore, regarding fish he is permitted, and from birds he is forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 54b:6:3.hebrew: נו"ן סמ"ך עי"ן כו' בסוף אוכלא - בסוף החולי, שכבר עבר זמן מרובה שחשש בעיניו, דהתם סם טוב לכאב העינים. והאי דקא תני "דגים קשים לעינים" — בתחלת אוכלא, כשהתחיל לחשוש בעיניו, ובשעת הנדר הוה תחלת אוכלא:
Rashi on Nedarim 54b:6:3.english: Nun, samekh, ayin, etc., at the end of the illness - At the end of the illness, when a long time has already passed since he began suffering in his eyes, for there [fish is] a good medicine for eye pain. And that which [the Gemara] stated, "fish are harmful for the eyes," [refers to] the beginning of the illness, when he [first] began to suffer in his eyes; and at the time of the vow it was the beginning of the illness.

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:2:1.english: [He is] prohibited [from eating] the head and the feet - For Rabbi Akiva holds that anything about which [an agent] consults is [considered] of its kind.

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:3:1.hebrew: מותר בראש - דסבר כתנא קמא דרבי עקיבא, דמימליך לא תוי מינו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:3:1.english: [He is] permitted [to eat] of the head - For he holds like the first tanna [who disputes] Rabbi Akiva, that [something about which an agent] consults [his employer] is not [considered] its kind.

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:3:2.english: With regard to purchase, [he is not a person] - For he leaves [aside] meat and buys innards.

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:5:1.hebrew: שהקיז דם - דקשיא לו, הילכך מותר בדגים וחגבים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:5:1.english: Where he let blood - For it is harmful to him; therefore, he is permitted fish and locusts [under his vow].

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:5:2.english: Birds too, it is not their custom to eat [them] - And why is he forbidden [from eating] birds?

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:5:3.hebrew: שאני עופות דאפשר ע"י שליקה - והא דאמר שמואל "פרח לבו", היינו ע"י צלי; אבל דגים — בין שלוק בין צלי קשה להקזה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:5:3.english: Birds are different, as it is possible by means of boiling - And that which Shmuel said, "his heart flies [like a bird]," that is [when eaten] by means of roasting; however, [as for] fish — whether boiled or roasted, it is harmful for bloodletting.

Tosafot on Nedarim 54b:6:1.english: The end of the ukhla - The end of the illness.
